title: Does red-cell size–dispersion coupling improve glucose-conditional HbA1c prediction? An exploratory recruitment-wave transport test
abstract: MCV–RDW coupling did not establish improved contemporaneous HbA1c prediction beyond flexible glucose and routine red-cell measures in exploratory NHANES2009–2010 to2015–2016 transport (5,170 source; 4,669 target adults): weighted MSE difference -0.00004075 HbA1c percentage-points², jointPSU-bootstrap95% interval [-0.00064294, 0.00124986].
